paper.title_en: Leptogenesis with a GeV-Scale Quasi-Dirac Neutrino
paper.abstract_en: We discuss leptogenesis in a model with a GeV-scale quasi-Dirac neutral lepton, comprising mainly sterile states, which is accessible to future experiments. In particular, we show that Higgs-decay leptogenesis can naturally arise from the type-I seesaw mechanism with spontaneously broken global lepton number together with a discrete $Z_2$ symmetry, yielding two quasi-degenerate right-handed neutrinos (RHNs) which, to excellent approximation, form a single Dirac neutrino, with a tiny mass splitting as required for resonant enhancement generated by higher-dimensional lepton-number-violating operators. Incorporating finite-temperature effects, we show that the observed baryon asymmetry can be successfully generated through thermal Higgs decays for 0.1-10 GeV mass quasi-Dirac neutrinos, with the CP asymmetry arising from the interplay between the vacuum and thermal contributions to the mass splitting. In the parameter region of successful leptogenesis, the quasi-Dirac neutrino is accessible to future heavy neutral lepton searches at SHiP, MATHUSLA and FCC-ee. In addition, the same symmetry-breaking sector gives rise to unstable domain walls whose annihilation can generate a stochastic gravitational-wave background, providing a complementary probe of the framework.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文在类型-I跷跷板机制框架下结合自发破缺的整体轻子数与离散Z2对称性讨论GeV尺度准狄拉克中微子的轻子生成，包含有限温度效应下的重子不对称计算；同时畴壁湮灭产生随机引力波背景，与脉冲星计时阵列等引力波探测形成互补检验，因而与pta主题相关。摘要对模型、机制、参数区间与观测量范围描述较完整，适合进一步阅读。
decision.title_zh: GeV尺度准狄拉克中微子的轻子生成
decision.abstract_zh: 我们讨论了在一个包含GeV尺度准狄拉克中性轻子的模型中的轻子生成，该中性轻子主要由惰性态构成，未来实验可以探测。特别地，我们表明，希格斯衰变轻子生成可以自然地产生于类型-I跷跷板机制，该机制具有自发破缺的整体轻子数以及离散的$Z_2$对称性，产生两个准简并的右手中微子（RHNs），它们在极好的近似下形成一个单一的狄拉克中微子，并具有微小质量劈裂，这正是由高维轻子数破坏算符产生的共振增强所需。计入有限温度效应，我们表明，对于0.1-10 GeV质量的准狄拉克中微子，可以通过热希格斯衰变成功产生观测到的重子不对称，其中CP不对称来自真空贡献与热贡献对质量劈裂的相互影响。在成功轻子生成的参数区域内，该准狄拉克中微子可被SHiP、MATHUSLA和FCC-ee未来的重中性轻子搜寻探测到。此外，同一对称性破缺部门会产生不稳定畴壁，其湮灭可以生成随机引力波背景，从而为该框架提供一种互补探针。
